'''Stone guardians''' were a series of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were used for discrete security across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by many different cultures.

==Description==
Stone guardians were droids with painted armored shells that were sculpted to resemble stone, rock, or marble. Designed to resemble decorative statues, these machines could be placed throughout many different sites, either freestanding or as support pillars. Equipped with passive sensors, the guardian is triggered by intruders or malignant forces intent on doing harm.<ref name="NoP" /> Their construction was made of a material that made them resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and they were capable of surviving [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire as well as explosives without suffering significant damage. The droid was programmed to be single minded in its mission at eliminating any intruders which it did by attacking with its limbs to crush its enemies. A mechanism was present in the torso of most droids that was a vital component of its operation. This addition was done so as a fail-safe for any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that fought the droid to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to simply twist the mechanism to deactivate the guard droid. Such a tactic was designed with specific focus on Jedi as [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were believed incapable of thinking of such a manner in defeating the droid.

==History==
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] used these droids throughout their facilities, including the [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|temple]] on [[Draay 2]] and within the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]], the lower levels of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="NoP" /> The guardian of the Draay 2 Temple was tasked with attacking any intruders that sought to acquire the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]]. An activation trigger for the droid was present on the floor on a single stone piece. In time, the temple itself would become lost and it became abandoned in time. It was only rediscovered by the Jedi Order during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who learnt of the Gauntlet within. To prevent it from falling in the hands of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] or the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] squad was dispatched under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'ink Utrila]]. They managed to enter into the temple where the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Glitch]] accidentally activated the guard droid. Despite Master Utrila and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] assistance, they were unable to stop the droid. However, Master Utrila realized the test of the guard droid where she and Omani used the Force to deactivate the droid through the mechanism on its torso.

[[File:ChamberOfAntiquities.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Stone guardians were situated in the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].]]

The droid, as a result, deactivated and returned to its statue-like pose where the Jedi marked the stone activation trigger. Afterwards, the expedition came under attack from [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who desired the Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger for themselves. They were overwhelmed and nearly defeated by the Death Watch until Glitch reactivated the guard droid that began attacking everyone in its path. This distraction later allowed Glitch to destroy the temple by intentionally failing one of the tests which led to a trap that brought the structure down along with the guard droid.

Several stone guardians guarded the [[Zardossa Stix Pyramid]] on [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]]. Their [[heavy energy projector]]s were more powerful than any other weapon on Zardossa. [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] clumsily activated them, but by throwing him around, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was able to get them to destroy each other using their own weapons. Jar Jar used one of the weapons against several [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] members in a successful attempt to rescue the [[Bardottan]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]].
